text: Iwarebiko fought Nagasunehiko once more, but the battle dragged on, the sky grew dark, and hail began to fall.
spoken: Eewahrehbeeko fought Nahgahsoonehheeko once more, but the battle dragged on, the sky grew dark, and hail began to fall.
